_doc: Curated 'ask this' prompts shown in the Ask AI UI, one set per role. Each question is written to be answerable from ask_ai/answer.py's actual context blocks (arc, phases, leading_vs_trailing, forecast, narrative, episodes, evidence, portfolio rows) — not aspirational. scope 'account' means it needs an account picked in the UI; 'portfolio' runs with no account_id. Quality-checked by scripts/eval_ask_ai_questions.py — see that script's README block for what 'checked' means and its limits (stub mode only, no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in this environment).
